subject: Intro + Discovery: scheduling with Eng lead, procurement & security
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@cloudnova.com>
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + discovery call — Redwood / CloudNova

Hi Alex,

Great to connect last week. As discussed, I want to get a short discovery call on the calendar so we can align on goals, scope, and make sure we bring the right folks from our side (AE + SE).

High-level goals for the intro:
- Understand CloudNova's key latency/cost targets for inference workloads
- Identify initial integration touchpoints and security/compliance constraints
- Confirm stakeholders and procurement timeline

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu Jan 7, 10:00–10:45am
- Fri Jan 8, 9:00–9:45am
- Mon Jan 11, 1:00–1:45pm

If these don't work, feel free to suggest a couple slots or I can send a quick Doodle. I suggest including Priya (engineering lead) and whoever handles procurement/security on your side so we can avoid follow-up cycles.

I can bring Stephanie (SE) and Marcus (Sales Engineering Manager). Estimated meeting length 45 minutes.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Discovery_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda stub)

Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 09:22:15 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Intro + discovery call — Redwood / CloudNova

Team — forwarding Alex's thread (below) so you have context. Can you confirm SE availability for the proposed windows? Important: procurement and security will probably want to join; needs a short agenda and a few technical questions answered up front.

Questions for Steph / Marcus:
- Are we fine with a 45-min cadence? Or should we reserve 60?
- Steph: any pre-reads we should send (perf benchmarks, architecture diagram)?
- Marcus: if procurement asks for SSO/KMS details, do we involve Security pre-call or keep it for post-discovery?

Thanks — planning to include a Doodle if Alex's team pushes back on slots.

Rachel
